payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: LeanCat, difficulty: medium).

Informal statement:
Let G and H be groups. If their binary coproduct exists in the category of groups, then the free product of G and H is isomorphic to that categorical coproduct.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem freeProdGrp_iso_coprod [HasBinaryCoproduct G H] :
    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) ≅ coprod G H)

The theorem is stated in this context (already in scope; do not restate it, and keep these when you write the proof):
open CategoryTheory Limits
universe u
variable {G H : GrpCat.{u}}

Use the typed subgoal tools to decompose, verify, review, and route. For this medium task, define four to six concrete compile-verifiable artifacts; do not use vague understand/find/investigate subgoals. Build at least two work subgoals plus one final integration subgoal; use sequential dependencies when the mathematics is sequential. Do not use HANDOFF or VERDICT text markers. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

{"code":"theorem universal_property {K : GrpCat} (f : G ⟶ K) (g : H ⟶ K) :
    ∃! (h : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ K),
      incl_G ≫ h = f ∧ incl_H ≫ h = g := by
  use GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (f.hom) (g.hom))
  constructor
  · -- Prove the diagram commutes
    constructor
    · -- incl_G ≫ h = f
      ext x
      simp [incl_G, GrpCat.ofHom_apply, Monoid.Coprod.lift_inl]
    · -- incl_H ≫ h = g
      ext x
      simp [incl_H, GrpCat.ofHom_apply, Monoid.Coprod.lift_inr]
  · -- Prove uniqueness
    intro h' hh
    apply GrpCat.ofHom_injective
    ext x
    -- Need to show that the underlying homomorphisms are equal
    sorry","subgoal_id":"subgoal2","purpose":"subgoal"}

    · -- incl_G ≫ h = f
      rw [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp Monoid.Coprod.inl (Monoid.Coprod.lift (f.hom) (g.hom))]
      rw [Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inl]
      rfl
    · -- incl_H ≫ h = g
      rw [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp Monoid.Coprod.inr (Monoid.Coprod.lift (f.hom) (g.hom))]
      rw [Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inr]

  · -- Prove uniqueness
    intro h' hh
    apply GrpCat.hom_ext

{"code":"theorem universal_property {K : GrpCat} (f : G ⟶ K) (g : H ⟶ K) :
    ∃! (h : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ K),
      (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl) ≫ h = f ∧ (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inr) ≫ h = g := by
  use GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift (f.hom) (g.hom))
  constructor
  · -- Prove the diagram commutes
    constructor
    · -- incl_G ≫ h = f
      rw [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp Monoid.Coprod.inl (Monoid.Coprod.lift (f.hom) (g.hom))]
      rw [Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inl]
      rfl
    · -- incl_H ≫ h = g
      rw [← GrpCat.ofHom_comp Monoid.Coprod.inr (Monoid.Coprod.lift (f.hom) (g.hom))]
      rw [Monoid.Coprod.lift_comp_inr]
      rfl
  · -- Prove uniqueness
    intro h' hh
    apply GrpCat.hom_ext
    -- From hh.1: (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl) ≫ h' = f
    -- Taking .hom on both sides:
    -- ((GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl) ≫ h').hom = f.hom
    -- Using GrpCat.hom_comp: h'.hom.comp (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl).hom = f.hom
    -- Using GrpCat.hom_ofHom: h'.hom.comp Monoid.Coprod.inl = f.hom
    have h1 : h'.hom.comp Monoid.Coprod.inl = f.hom := by
      calc
        h'.hom.comp Monoid.Coprod.inl = h'.hom.comp (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl).hom := by rw [GrpCat.hom_ofHom]
        _ = ((GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl) ≫ h').hom := by rw [← GrpCat.hom_comp]
        _ = f.hom := by rw [hh.1]
    have h2 : h'.hom.comp Monoid.Coprod.inr = g.hom := by
      calc
        h'.hom.comp Monoid.Coprod.inr = h'.hom.comp (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inr).hom := by rw [GrpCat.hom_ofHom]
        _ = ((GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inr) ≫ h').hom := by rw [← GrpCat.hom_comp]
        _ = g.hom := by rw [hh.2]
    -- Use Monoid.Coprod.lift_unique
    rw [← Monoid.Coprod.lift_unique h1 h2]","subgoal_id":"subgoal2","purpose":"subgoal"}

  let inr' : H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) := GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inr
  let cocone' : BinaryCofan G H := BinaryCofan.mk inl' inr'
  
  -- Show that cocone' is a colimit
  have h_colimit' : IsColimit cocone' := by
    -- Use the universal property of Monoid.Coprod.lift
    sorry
  
  -- The coprod G H is also a colimit (by coprodIsCoprod)
  have h_colimit : IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk coprod.inl coprod.inr) := coprodIsCoprod G H
  
  -- Use the uniqueness of colimits up to isomorphism
  have h_iso : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ≅ coprod G H :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso h_colimit' h_colimit
  
  exact ⟨h_iso⟩","subgoal_id":"subgoal2","purpose":"subgoal"}

    Nonempty (GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ≅ coprod G H) := by
  -- Use the fact that both GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) and coprod G H
  -- satisfy the universal property of the coproduct, and hence are isomorphic.
  -- We construct the isomorphism using the universal property.
  
  -- First, construct a morphism from GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) to coprod G H
  -- using the universal property of coprod G H
  let f : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ⟶ coprod G H :=
    coprod.desc (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inl) (GrpCat.ofHom Monoid.Coprod.inr)
  
  -- Next, construct a morphism from coprod G H to GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H)
  -- using the universal property of GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H)
  let g : coprod G H ⟶ GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) :=
    GrpCat.ofHom (Monoid.Coprod.lift coprod.inl.hom coprod.inr.hom)
  
  -- Show that f and g are inverses
  have h1 : f ≫ g = 1 := by
    -- Use the uniqueness of the morphism from coprod G H to GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H)
    -- that makes the diagram commute
    apply GrpCat.hom_ext
    ext x
    sorry
  have h2 : g ≫ f = 1 := by
    -- Use the uniqueness of the morphism from GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod G H) to coprod G H
    -- that makes the diagram commute
    apply GrpCat.hom_ext
    ext x
    sorry
  
  -- Construct the isomorphism
  let iso : GrpCat.of (Monoid.Coprod ↑G ↑H) ≅ coprod G H :=
    { hom := f, inv := g, hom_inv_id := h2, inv_hom_id := h1 }
  
  exact ⟨iso⟩","subgoal_id":"subgoal2","purpose":"subgoal"}
